collection.title: Peugeot 405 Estate 1988 to 1997 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Peugeot 405 Estate 1988 to 1997 model requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the hook type arm attachment. This model has built-in washer jets.
